manifestations: 回避与朋友分享Anxiety与财务压力
独自承受压力而not主动寻求支持

target_behavior.function: 逃避not确定性与羞耻感,获得短期的'Interpretation感/控制感',同时为not行动找到理由.
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety worsened,Disturbed sleep and appetite,Decline in work performance,问题解决被延宕.
